findings.summary: Verisum reduces the hallucination rate on Tamsin-News to 8.7%, compared to 11.0% for Corran-Sum with salience pre-filtering and 15.1% for Corran-Sum alone.
findings.scope: Tamsin-News test split (3,000 articles), hallucination rate metric (lower is better), single training run per system
findings.caveats: No statistical tests reported; differences are descriptive only.

findings.summary: The reduction from Corran-Sum to Corran-Sum + salience filter is 4.0 percentage points (from 15.1% to 11.0%), which is smaller than the additional reduction from Corran-Sum + salience filter to Verisum (2.3 percentage points, from 11.0% to 8.7%).
findings.scope: Tamsin-News test split, hallucination rate metric
findings.caveats: No statistical tests reported; single run per system.
